responsibility: This module is the GCC target backend for the Xilinx MicroBlaze architecture, covering both the generic ELF port and its Linux and RTEMS subtargets. It defines the architecture’s compile-time ABI and toolchain interface in the target headers, target-specific command-line options and feature selection, and C-family predefined macros that expose selected CPU, endianness, and hardware capabilities. Its core implementation files bind MicroBlaze behavior into GCC through TARGET hooks for calling conventions, frame layout, addressing and constant legitimacy, PIC/TLS and small-data handling, section selection, cost and scheduling decisions, asm output, and machine-dependent RTL lowering and reorganization. The machine-description files provide the instruction patterns, predicates, constraints, synchronization/atomic sequences, and scheduling attributes that drive instruction selection, reload, and final emission, making this module the place where generic GCC code generation is specialized into correct and efficient MicroBlaze code and OS-specific binary conventions.
